title: COKE: Customizable Fine-Grained Story Evaluation via Chain-of-Keyword Rationalization

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model story evaluation scores against the average ratings of a diverse population of human annotators to measure and mitigate deviations caused by the model's alignment to specific annotator tastes rather than the broader audience.

Analyzing the frequency of specific pronouns and sentiment words in positive versus negative rationales, and performing ablation studies (such as removing the story input) to demonstrate that the scoring model overly relies on explanation artifacts to predict ratings rather than the actual story content.
